title.narrative: Building Peoples Organizations' Capacities to Claim their Rights and Sustainable Development

description.narrative: The overall objective of the Action is to build capacities of communities and peoples movements to face globalization and claim their rights. Specifically, APRN will build capacities of peoples' organisations (sectoral organisations of marginalised sectors such as small farmers, fishers, urban poor, women, youth, children, etc.)
